scripts.still: bun build.ts && slopcamera html still --input out/scene.json --at 3,8,12,17,21,26,31,36,41 --output out/stills
scripts.still:portrait: bun build.ts --aspect 9:16 && slopcamera html still --input out/portrait/scene.json --at 3,8,12,17,21,26,31,36,41 --output out/portrait/stills
scripts.render: bun build.ts && slopcamera html render --input out/scene.json --json > out/export.json
scripts.render:portrait: bun build.ts --aspect 9:16 && slopcamera html render --input out/portrait/scene.json --json > out/portrait/export.json
scripts.deliver: slopcamera html deliver out/export.json --basename aicharts-launch --poster-at 12 --social-at 17 --cuts 1:1 --beats out/beats.json --per-beat-clips --output out/deliver
scripts.render:square: bun build.ts --aspect 1:1 && slopcamera html render --input out/square/scene.json --json > out/square/export.json
scripts.deliver:square: slopcamera html deliver out/square/export.json --basename aicharts-launch-square --poster-at 12 --social-at 17 --beats out/square/beats.json --output out/deliver-square
scripts.deliver:portrait: slopcamera html deliver out/portrait/export.json --basename aicharts-launch-vertical --poster-at 12 --social-at 17 --beats out/portrait/beats.json --per-beat-clips --output out/deliver-vertical
